_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
I ye jɛkulu {player_id} o Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
I ka kɛlɛnden ye '{symbol}'.
I bɛɛ sɛbɛn kɛlɛnden kɔnɔntɔn 5x5 kɔnɔntɔn fɛrɛ kɛlɛndenw bɛɛ kɔnɔntɔn.
Kɛlɛndenw bɛɛ kɔnɔntɔn yeelima in kɛlɛ, kɔrɔ, walla diagonal.
Sɛbɛn kɛlɛnden kɔnɔntɔn '[4]' kɔnɔntɔn fɛrɛ kɛlɛnden 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛlɛnden fɛrɛ bɛɛ kɔnɔntɔn. Sɛbɛn '[cell]' kɔnɔntɔn ye 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kɛlɛnden bɛɛ kɔnɔntɔn: {cell}. Yeelima in kɛ 0 aurɛ {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Jɛkulu {player_id} ka kɛlɛnden a ye ({symbol}) kɔnɔntɔn fɛrɛ ({row}, {col}).
